# Offline regions explained

Download a region once and Quarry Maps keeps it for 30 days without a connection. Each region is capped at 1.2 GB; larger areas are split into tiles. Turn-by-turn works offline, but live traffic and transit times do not. Regions refresh automatically on Wi-Fi when charging.
